instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a data compression and decompression block. 
The module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of 8-bit data signals (data_in)
Outputs: a set of 4-bit compressed data signals (data_out)
The module should implement the following functionality:

The circuit should compress the 8-bit input data into 4-bit compressed data using a simple compression algorithm.
The algorithm should group the input data into pairs of two bytes, and replace each pair with a single 4-bit code.
For example, if the input data is 00110011 00001111, the compressed data should be 0101 0010.
The algorithm should use the following codes:
00 - both bytes are zeros
01 - both bytes are the same and non-zero
10 - the first byte is zero and the second byte is non-zero
11 - the first byte is non-zero and the second byte is zero
The circuit should also be able to decompress the compressed data back into the original 8-bit data.
To implement the compression and decompression blocks, you should use Verilog code to define the compression and decompression algorithms as Boolean functions of the input signals. 
You should then use these functions to connect the inputs to the compression and decompression circuits.
Finally, you should use the compressed data to compute the output signals.
